CardDescription.DefaultText:
A furnace hot enough to smelt copper. Requires bellows or a windy location to reach high enough temperatures.

Can be lit with tinder, provided it has enough fuel.
CardDescription.Text: 温度足以熔炼铜的熔炉。需要风箱或在多风的区域才能达到足够高的温度。\n\n只要有足够的燃料，就可以用火绒点燃。

CardDescription.en: A furnace hot enough to smelt copper. Requires bellows or a windy location to reach high enough temperatures.\n\nCan be lit with tinder, provided it has enough fuel.
CardDescription.ja: 銅の精錬に必要な高温を生み出せる炉。十分な温度に達するには、ふいごまたは風通しの良い場所が必要。\n\n十分な燃料があれば、焚き付けで点火できる。
